summary: Sections that expand in place, for content most people will not need to read.

pairs.dont: Pick the icon pair by taste.
pairs.do: faq (plus/minus) for answers that appear; default (chevrons) for sections that unfold.
pairs.why: This is the only thing the axis changes, and it is the only signal people get about what the control will do.

pairs.dont: Hide the thing the page is about behind a closed section.
pairs.do: Collapse what most people will skip — edge cases, detail, history.
pairs.why: Anything collapsed is not found, not read and not searchable on the page. That is the cost of every closed row.

pairs.do: Say what is inside — the trigger is the only thing visible when closed.
pairs.why: A closed accordion is a list of its own labels. If the labels say nothing, the list says nothing.

pairs.dont: Default to multiple open just to avoid choosing.
pairs.do: Single for comparison-free reading, multiple when people cross-reference sections.
pairs.why: Single keeps the page short; multiple keeps two answers side by side. Which one is right depends on the reading, not the component.

pairs.dont: Add a rule under the last item to close the list off.
pairs.do: Put the divider above each item after the first.
pairs.why: The rule separates items. A trailing one draws a line under nothing.
